label: Cycle and division
text: BI.O.A2.4 Cycle and division. Replication, segregation and division, with checkpoints. Mitosis preserves ploidy. Meiosis halves ploidy and recombines homologues.

warrant.standard: Perturbation with controls; imaging with stated resolution; replication across cell lines
warrant.defeaters: Fixation artefact; overexpression artefact; cell-line misidentification
